verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Each puts the two-line headline on the left and squeezes the cat illustration, the original's hero image, into a small cluster at the right edge, leaving a dead purple gap between them. At 50 px tall the cats are barely readable, so the illustration becomes trivial. A's cats are slightly larger and bleed off the bottom edge as in the original, which keeps a little more of the imagery's presence. B's cats are smaller and its cluster sits a bit closer to the headline, which makes the right side look more like an afterthought.
